trust.registry: Use the registry blob from the protected full base SHA, never the changed head registry. The first promotion requires a separately reviewed SHA-256 pin.
trust.checker: CI must execute the checker from the protected base, not pull-request code.
trust.laneInput: CI must load its writer plan from an externally approved immutable policy commit with an independently reviewed SHA-256 pin supplied by protected configuration. The separate policy commit binds the already-known exact base/head SHA and one lane for every changed path, avoiding a self-referential Git SHA cycle. Candidate-provided refs/pins/plans are not trusted.
trust.scope: This local CLI is preparatory until the protected workflow/check and independent policy review are installed.
